title: Eric Lopes refuses to talk and threatens film crew

plain: The documentary filmmaker James Fox says that when he and his crew went to Varginha, a town in Brazil, looking for a man named Eric Lopes, they were told: "If you're here to talk about the ET, he won't talk," and were then threatened with being shot. Fox tells Michels this as someone who was there, and the refusal suggests that the subject of a creature said to have been seen in Varginha is still one people there fear.
